captions.detailed: This is a full-size camera speedlight flash unit with a dark matte finish. It features a rectangular battery housing at the base with a side control strip holding individual mode buttons, a tall cylindrical neck, and a wide flash head with rounded sides and a light grey front diffuser. The neck is capable of continuous horizontal rotation, while the flash head tilts vertically on a horizontal hinge, and each of the side buttons is designed to depress independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional-scale camera speedlight flash unit. The model should include a deep battery base with a side control panel holding multiple individual buttons, a tall neck that swivels continuously on a vertical axis, and a wide flash head with rounded sides and a light-grey front diffuser that can tilt on a horizontal hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the speedlight's base using a combination of box and cylinder primitives to form the main housing, battery compartment, and side control panel. Model the neck as a cylinder connected to the base via a continuous rotational joint. Build the head cradle and the head itself using box primitives with filleted/rounded edges, adding a light-grey box for the front diffuser, and link it to the neck with a revolute tilt joint. Add small individual box primitives along the side of the base as separate prismatic button links.
